topic: Linking website to track daily impressions
summary_markdown: A request was made to find a plug-in or method to automatically update the number of daily impressions on a website for V&A. It was discussed that a data API exists and provides impression reports, but either the client must pull the data themselves or specify where/how the file should be pushed.
decisions: The available solution involves using the existing data API for impression reports.
action_items: Add Tolya to the chat thread to explain the details of the data API.
